description: This file defines the class AcknowledgementLabelNotUniqueException, a specialized runtime exception thrown when acknowledgement labels are not unique within a messaging or acknowledgement system. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization, provides a static singleton instance, and offers a builder pattern for customization.
